class PowercoreTestConf(TestConf):
    config_file = ""

    def __init__(
        self,
        host,
        port=9000,
        config_file=None,
        config_unit="unit",
        is_96k_conf=False,
        compare_upload={}
    ):
        """
        Add this to `conftest.py` to configure the `powercore` fixture.
        ```
        @fixture
        async def powercore_config() -> PowercoreTestConf:
            return PowercoreTestConf("127.0.0.1", 9000)
        ```
        """
        super().__init__(host, port, None)
        self.config_file = config_file
        self.config_unit = config_unit
        self.is_96k_conf = is_96k_conf
        self.compare_upload = compare_upload

@fixture
async def powercore(
    powercore_config: PowercoreTestConf,
    powercore_config_upload: PowerCoreConfigUpload | None
):
    powecore_device = LawoPowercoreDevice([])

    if powercore_config_upload is not None:
        powecore_device.log.info(f"uploading: {powercore_config_upload.file} (unit={powercore_config_upload.unit})")

        await powecore_device.upload_config(
            powercore_config_upload.file,
            powercore_config_upload.unit,
            powercore_config.host,
        )

    ember_client = await new_connection(powercore_config.host, powercore_config.port)
    powecore_device.ember = ember_client

    yield powecore_device

    await powecore_device.ember.teardown()
